title: Mathematical model for sustainable fisheries resource management accounting for size spectrum
summary: This paper proposes a novel modelling and control framework for growth models that incorporate a size spectrum in conjunction with numerical computation and extensive field surveys. In fisheries management, the size spectrum, characterized by individual differences in body weight and length, is a critical factor, as it influences the physiology and ecology of fish, as well as the preferences of anglers.
